thig4.1:1.1: putto buddhassa dāyādo Kassapo susamāhito | pubbenivāsaṃ yo vedī saggāpāyañ ca passati. || ||
thig4.1:2.1: atho jātikkhayaṃ patto abhiññāvosito muni | etāhi tīhi vijjāhi tevijjo hoti brāhmaṇo. || ||
thig4.1:3.1: tatheva Bhaddā Kapilānī tevijjā maccuhāyinī | dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ jetvā Māraṃ savāhanaṃ. || ||
thig4.1:4.1: disvā ādīnavaṃ loke ubho pabbajitā mayaṃ | ty amha khīṇāsavā dantā sītibhūta mha nibbutā ti. || ||
